info.title: MyPreflight oceanic tracks provider
info.description:
An AWS Lambda function returning today's organised oceanic tracks, with every fix placed on the map. It serves the Pacific tracks (PACOTS) from the FAA NOTAM Management Service and the North Atlantic tracks (NAT) from the FAA's public NAT track feed.

Served from a Lambda Function URL. Every request must carry the function secret as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`; the function answers 401 before doing anything else otherwise.

servers.description: The Lambda Function URL, published at the SSM parameter /mypreflight/oceanic-tracks-provider/url

get.description:
Returns every track currently published, westbound PACOTS from Oakland (KZAK), eastbound PACOTS from Fukuoka (RJJJ), and the North Atlantic tracks from Gander (CZQX, usually eastbound) and Shanwick (EGGX, usually westbound), each with its validity, route, the fixes placed on the map and the raw message.

When the NAT feed is unavailable the Pacific tracks are still returned without the North Atlantic ones, and that answer is not cached.

Points written as latitude and longitude, such as `52N140W` or the North Atlantic `55/20` and `5430/20`, are placed from their own text. Named fixes and navaids are placed from the FAA's published aeronautical data; a name that exists in more than one place takes the one nearest its neighbours on the track, and a fix nobody can place is listed in `unresolvedFixes` rather than guessed.

The function takes no arguments. The assembled tracks are cached in the function instance for 5 minutes, and fix positions for 24 hours, which keeps the function well inside the FAA's limit of one data pull every 3 minutes.

401.description: Missing or wrong bearer token; the function refuses the request with UNAUTHORIZED

500.description: The FAA credentials are not configured, or an unexpected failure

502.description: The FAA NOTAM service or the FAA fix directory is unreachable, refused the request or answered with something unreadable

bearerAuth.description: The function secret, generated by the OpenTofu stack and published at the SSM parameter /mypreflight/oceanic-tracks-provider/secret

fetchedAt.description: When the function read the tracks from the FAA.

tracks.description: Ordered by issuing authority, then track identifier.

unreadableMessages.description: NOTAM numbers of track messages the function found but could not read. Empty on a normal day; anything here means the published format changed.

system.description: The organised track system the track belongs to.

identifier.description: The track's published name: a letter for Oakland's westbound tracks, a number for Fukuoka's eastbound ones, a letter for the North Atlantic tracks.

issuingAuthority.description: ICAO location of the unit that published the track.

notamNumber.description: The NOTAM carrying the track. A Fukuoka message and a North Atlantic message carry several tracks, so they share it.

route.description: The oceanic part of the track as published, without the connecting routes.

levels.description: Flight levels the track is published for in its direction, such as 340 for FL340. PACOTS messages publish none, so the list is empty.

fixes.description: Every fix on the route that could be placed, in route order.

unresolvedFixes.description: Fixes on the route that could not be placed, in route order. They are left out of `fixes` rather than guessed.

remarks.description: The track's remarks, one per line. A North Atlantic message's remarks, its TMI among them, apply to every track in it. Null when the message publishes none.

message.description: The NOTAM text exactly as published, connecting routes included. A North Atlantic message published in parts is joined in order, one line per line.

ident.description: The fix as written in the route: a name, or a point such as 52N140W or 5430/20.
